Nice and original. I really enjoyed the idea behind this one and the relationship between Hiccup and Toothless is definitely the best part. I love how the story turns the usual idea of dragons being dangerous creatures into something much more interesting. Hiccup and Toothless slowly learning to trust each other gives the film a lot of heart. The animation is also beautiful, especially during the flying scenes. The visuals and the soundtrack make the world feel much bigger and more magical. The story is fairly simple but it works well, and the characters are likeable without feeling too complicated. A really charming and original animated film.

The film features great world-building with refreshing new elements, and while it's built on an age old fairy tale screenplay structure, it's executed so well that it never becomes boring. However, the character of Astrid suffers a bit in the writing. She has a distinct, strong personality during the first half of the film, but by the later half, she essentially becomes a cardboard character who exists just to fall in love with the protagonist. I really wish she could have fallen in love on her own terms, without having to lose her unique edge and personality in the process, Also hiccup definitely does not sound like a teenager wish we could've had an actual teenager as voice actor but it is what it is, I guess.

Os personagens são legais, o Banguela é daora, mas o filme inteiro passa sem deixar muita marca na minha visão.
